title: You’re not “unclean” because of what you ate.
paragraphs:
You’re not “unclean” because of what you ate.
You’re unclean because of what you hide.
Because the problem was never the pig…
There’s something the Law was exposing…
Why would God divide animals so specifically?
Why label some as clean… and others as unclean?
Why make something so ordinary feel so heavy?
Was meant to confront something deeper.
We don’t like categories that expose us
But the standard wasn’t “better than others.”
And suddenly… we all fall short
You may not eat unclean animals.
The bitterness you rehearse at night?
The lust you entertain in secret?
The pride you dress up as confidence?
The quiet compromises no one else sees?

You can look clean outside…
and still be unclean within.

“Nothing outside a person can defile them by going into them…
Rather, it is what comes out of a person that defiles them.”
— Mark 7:15, 20
And this is where many people miss it…
The Law was never meant to save you.
It was meant to expose you.
“You shall be holy, for I am holy.” — Leviticus 11:44
God wasn’t just giving dietary restrictions.
Holding that standard up like a mirror to humanity.
And what did the mirror show?
It showed that no matter how disciplined you are…
Some scholars interpret the clean and unclean laws as both ceremonial distinctions and health wisdom for ancient Israel.
A deeper cleansing that had to come.
The ones society labeled “don’t come near.”
This is the Gospel (don’t miss this)
You were never going to fix yourself.
You were never going to purify your own heart.
So Jesus did what the Law could never do.

“God made Him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.”
— 2 Corinthians 5:21
And He carried it to the cross.
And still live like nothing changed.
Jesus didn’t die to make you look better.
He died to make you new.
When Peter saw the vision of clean and unclean animals together, God said:

“Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”
— Acts 10:15
Are you still holding onto what Jesus already died to cleanse?
Are you hiding behind religion to avoid real surrender?
And still be far from God.
You don’t need to fix yourself first.

Sees your sin
Knows your thoughts
Understands your struggle
And still says…
Bring Him the parts of you no one else sees.
Because the cross wasn’t built for perfect people.
It was built for the unclean.
You don’t have to stay that way.

From unclean… to redeemed.
From hidden… to healed.
